advisory.summary: Out-of-bounds write in Google's reference Brotli C decoder; reachable from Node.js' bundled copy, Python Brotli/brotlicffi wheels, and anything linking libbrotli.

products.eol_note: Lines 25, 23, 20 and older are end-of-life with no fix published: move to 22, 24 or 26.
products.note: Node.js bundles its own Brotli decoder, so the system libbrotli version is irrelevant to this runtime. Express and body-parser are only paths to it; upgrading them does not help.
PyPI Brotli links the C decoder. pip-audit, Dependabot and Safety did not reliably flag the affected versions at disclosure.
brotlicffi wraps the same C decoder; it is pulled in transitively by urllib3/requests/aiohttp/httpx.
Dynamically linked programs are fixed once the distribution ships a patched package and the process restarts. Statically linked or vendored copies need their own rebuild.
A vendored copy is not covered by distribution updates. Patched copies include the BLOCK_SWITCH error code (-17) in brotli/decode.h; a copy without it predates the fix.
